title: People’s Mañanera October 13
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Security with Results: Homicides Down 52%  
** In two years, Mexico went from registering 86.9 to 42.2 homicides per
day—that is, 45 fewer each day—and high-impact crimes decreased by 36%. The
strategy combines addressing root causes, intelligence activity, and
coordination.

**Investment in Prison Infrastructure and Social Reintegration  
** The Mexican government will build six new high-security prisons, with a
capacity for 18,480 inmates, scheduled for completion by 2028. They will
include educational and work facilities, prioritizing security and human
rights.

**More Hospitals, Better Salaries, and Healthcare for the People  
** In two years, 34 new hospitals were built, 650 operating rooms were
renovated, and 300 million doses of medications were distributed. Specialty
consultations increased by 36%, and 55,722 healthcare workers were granted
permanent employment status. In addition, a 5.1% salary increase was announced
for IMSS employees.

**Jalisco: Sheinbaum Demands Explanations for Repression of Protesters  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum declared that Jalisco Governor Pablo Lemus must
answer for the police action against those demanding clean water. The National
Water Commission (Conagua) is working on a solution while the Ministry of the
Interior is investigating allegations of possible torture and human rights
violations.

**“Mexico Is Not Alone; It Stands with the People”: Sheinbaum  
** The President highlighted the popular support for her government and
presented a poll that ranks her first in approval ratings among Latin American
leaders. Sheinbaum reaffirmed that Mexico’s greatest strength is its people,
who accompany and sustain the Transformation.
